change: Client died at window creation with 420 or more jars in `mods/`
details: Status was Complete, moved to the archive 2026-11-16; Tests: C+. **r1115 phase 10: jar handle gate PASSED: CQ-FDR-01 to -04 (421 jars, 419 filesystems closed, 1091 -> 672 descriptors; three sessions without ClosedFileSystemException; without the mixin the crash returns; no line on a dedicated server).** Run r1114 phase 2 (cq_pwg17 client, 03:10 to 03:16): `*** stack smashing detected ***: terminated` right after KubeJS "Loaded client.properties", 22 to 23 s after launch, also outside the sandbox. Isolated over seven launches: 419 jars reach the title screen (any mix: Packet Fixer in and Clear Void out also starts), 420 or more die, whichever jar is added (Packet Fixer only, Debugify only). The instance `mods/` has 421 (Debugify 1.1.0 and Packet Fixer 3.3.2 added 2026-11-13, plus `backportedPowerGrid-0.6.2-ce-19.2-17.jar`, which has no `mod_sides.md` row and belongs in scratch only): the owner's next client launch from this instance very likely dies. **Fixed 2026-11-14 ([jar_handle_leak.md](../jar_handle_leak.md))**: cause confirmed: FML's service discovery opens every mod jar and never closes it (securejarhandler keeps the filesystem and its zip open), so each jar holds two descriptors, 1091 open before glfwInit; GLFW's X11 connection and wakeup pipe got numbers of 1024 or higher and its select() overflowed. Creative Common 1.2.0 (`StaleJarHandles`, `FdReleaseMixin`) closes the leaked discovery copies before glfwInit: 1091 -> 672, a scratch client with 421 jars reached the title screen. Installed in `mods/`. (A separate reserve jar, Creative Boot, worked too but was dropped: a service jar cannot be a mod.) Open: CQ-FDR-02 to -04. launch logs `cli17/launch_*.out` in the run's scratchpad. Not fixed (mods/ is the owner's).
